problem.signedOut: Your session ended: sign in again.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
problem.notFound: This die is gone or not one you can see.
problem.conflict: Someone changed it meanwhile: read it again and retry.
problem.rateLimited: Too many requests: wait a moment and try again.
problem.unavailable: The service does not answer: try again shortly.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on our side: try again.

field.code: The number: letters, digits and - _ / . without spaces.
field.size: Pick a size of the style, or none for every size.
field.rackLocation: Write where it hangs, or leave it empty.
field.material: Write what it is made of, or leave it empty.
field.purchaseCost: A cost from 0, in euro and cents.
field.supplierId: Pick a supplier of the group.

refusal.DIE_RETIRED: The die is retired: only its note changes.
refusal.DIE_NUMBER_TAKEN: This number is taken: every die carries its own.
refusal.SIZE_NOT_IN_STYLE: This size is not in the style's size range.
refusal.PIECE_OTHER_STYLE: This pattern piece belongs to another style.
refusal.CONDITION_RETIRED_BY_RETIRE: A die is retired with Retire, with the reason.
refusal.STYLE_UNKNOWN: This style is not one of the group's.

die.codeHint: The number stamped on the die; it never changes.
die.sizeHint: One size of the style, or every size.
die.noPattern: This style's pattern is not in Nexus: write the piece.
die.patternPieceHint: Optional: ties the die to the pattern piece.
die.pieceHint: As the pattern names it ("Front left").
die.materialHint: What it is made of ("steel rule").
die.costProblem: An amount from 0, with at most two decimals.

dies.noMatchBody: Change the search or the rows shown.
dies.emptyBody: Register the cutting room's dies: number, style, size, piece and where they hang.
dies.foot: Pattern revision and strokes per die come later.
dies.footCost: The cost shows only with the cost grain. Pattern revision and strokes per die come later.

held.noManage: Your role does not keep the register (plant.machines.manage).

newDie.title: New die
newDie.foot: It is registered in good condition.

retire.reachKept: It stays in the register for its history, among the retired.
retire.reachFrozen: Once retired only its note changes; the reason is added to the note.
retire.reversal: There is no way back: if the piece is still cut, register a new die.
